Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 2005
ACT I OF 2005
Provincial Law Officers (Amendment) Act 2005
An act to amend the
Provincial Law Officers Ordinance, 2001 (XX of 2001)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary. 20th April,
2005]
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This
Act may be called the Provincial Law Officers (Amendment) Act, 2005.
(2)
It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on
the 1st day of December, 2002.

Amendment of sections 2 and 3 of Ordinance XX of 2001

ACT I OF 2005
ACT I OF 2005
Provincial Law Officers (Amendment) Act 2005
An act to amend the
Provincial Law Officers Ordinance, 2001 (XX of 2001)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary. 20th April,
2005]
2. Amendment of sections 2 and 3 of Ordinance XX of 2001.--In the Provincial Law Officers Ordinance, 2001, in
sections 2 and 3 for the word "Governor" wherever occurring the word
"Chief Minister" shall be substituted.
